# VoyageMara Safaris

> Official entity information, safari packages, destination coverage, and contact specifications for VoyageMara Safaris (Nairobi, Kenya).

## Company Information
- Name: VoyageMara Safaris
- Founder & Safari Director: Duncan Ronkorua
- Headquarters: Nairobi, Kenya
- Primary Service: Tailor-made wildlife safaris, small-group joining tours, and luxury private game drives across Kenya
- Operating Hours: Daily, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM East Africa Time (EAT)
- Official Website: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/
- Official Booking Hotline (Phone & WhatsApp): +254 705 814 181
- Official Email: kariadan831@gmail.com
- Direct Booking Link: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/#contact

## Safari Fleet & Guiding Standards
- Safari Vehicles: Custom-built 4x4 Toyota Land Cruisers with pop-up observation roofs, high-clearance suspension, long-range fuel tanks, UHF communication radios, and USB charging points.
- Safari Guides: Certified native Maasai driver-guides born and raised in Kenyan wildlife ecosystems, with professional tracking expertise and in-depth knowledge of animal behavior.
- Transparent Quotations: Safari quotes include round-trip 4x4 transport from Nairobi, all national park and reserve entrance fees, full-board lodging/tented camp stays, professional guide services, and bottled mineral water.

## Featured Safari Packages (2026 / 2027)

### 1. 3-Day Maasai Mara Big Five Safari
- Duration: 3 Days / 2 Nights
- Location: Maasai Mara National Reserve, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$620 per person sharing
- Highlights: Big Five game drives (lions, leopards, elephants, buffalos, rhinos), the Great Wildebeest Migration (July–October), luxury tented camp stays, Mara River crossings, and certified Maasai guides.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/maasai-mara

### 2. 2-Day Amboseli Elephant & Kilimanjaro Safari
- Duration: 2 Days / 1 Night
- Location: Amboseli National Park, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$520 per person sharing
- Highlights: Iconic views of Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's largest free-ranging elephant herds, open swamp birdlife, and panoramic landscape photography.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/amboseli

### 3. 3-Day Samburu Northern Special Five Safari
- Duration: 3 Days / 2 Nights
- Location: Samburu National Reserve, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$750 per person sharing
- Highlights: Endemic northern species (Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, gerenuk, Somali ostrich, beisa oryx) along the Ewaso Nyiro River.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/samburu

### 4. 1-Day Lake Nakuru Rhino & Flamingo Safari
- Duration: 1 Day
- Location: Lake Nakuru National Park, Great Rift Valley, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$450 per person
- Highlights: Protected black and white rhino sanctuary, Rothschild giraffes, and Great Rift Valley birdlife.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/lake-nakuru

### 5. 1-Day Lake Naivasha Boat & Crescent Island Tour
- Duration: 1 Day
- Location: Lake Naivasha & Crescent Island, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$300 per person
- Highlights: Freshwater boat ride past wild hippo pods, waterbirds, and a walking safari alongside zebras and giraffes on Crescent Island.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/lake-naivasha

### 6. 1-Day Nairobi National Park Day Safari
- Duration: 1 Day (Morning or Afternoon)
- Location: Nairobi National Park, Nairobi, Kenya
- Starting Price: From US$180 per person
- Highlights: Big Four wildlife viewing just 15 minutes from Nairobi city center and JKIA Airport.
- Package URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/nairobi-national-park

## Booking & Inquiry Process
1. Travellers can submit custom dates, guest counts, and accommodation preferences through the online booking modal on the website.
2. Direct inquiries can be initiated 24/7 on WhatsApp via +254 705 814 181.
3. Quotations are customized based on season (peak migration vs shoulder/green season), preferred camp tier (luxury vs mid-range), and group size.
